job.title: Mobile UX Designer (Android & iOS)
job.description: Wavepath Mobility is a Gurugram B2C startup building a ride-pooling super-app for metro commuters. We are hiring a Mobile UX Designer who understands the nuances of native Android and iOS design conventions while maintaining a consistent cross-platform brand. You will design booking flows, driver/rider dashboards, and real-time map interactions. Experience with Maps SDK overlays and motion design for transitions is a plus. We iterate fast with biweekly sprints.

pool.text: Figma: designed 60+ screens across Android and iOS, respecting Material You and Apple HIG conventions including adaptive layout and safe area handling
Map UI design: prototyped map interaction flows using Figma's map community plugins; documented overlay layer hierarchy for engineering
UX Design Intern at RideSwift (Bengaluru, 6 months): designed driver app home screen, trip-status bottom sheet, and earnings summary screen; participated in bi-weekly user interviews with drivers

Poolio concept: full UX for a ride-pooling app — persona research, flow maps, Android hi-fi Figma prototype, 3-day unmoderated Maze test with 18 participants; redesign reduced booking steps from 7 to 4
iOS Human Interface Guidelines: applied HIG rules for safe areas, back-swipe gestures, sheet presentations and haptic feedback spec
Motion design: specified transition animations (enter/exit, shared-element) in a motion spec document; annotated durations and easing curves for each screen transition
B.Des Interaction Design, IDC School of Design, IIT Bombay, 2022–2026, CGPA 8.3/10
User research: conducted 10 contextual inquiries with auto-rickshaw commuters in Pune to inform mental-model mapping
PySpark: processed a 10 GB ride-dataset for a data engineering assignment; not related to design work
Component organisation in Figma: structured frames by feature, used named auto-layout frames and page splits to keep 300+ screen file manageable
SafeRoute: location-sharing safety feature UX for a women's mobility app — dark-mode hi-fi, panic-button micro-interaction, emergency contact flow
Handoff: used Figma's Dev Mode to generate redlines and annotated spec sheets consumed by Android and iOS engineers
